# blender-composition-camera-planner (reference summary)

## Purpose
Provide detailed composition and camera planning for product hero outputs.

Design high-quality composition/camera strategy for product hero scenes in plain, actionable language.

## Metadata & truth boundary
- **Canonical skill:** `skills/blender-composition-camera-planner/SKILL.md`
- **Contract:** `skills/blender-composition-camera-planner/contract.json` (`v1.0.0`)
- **Category / role:** `scene-planners` / `camera-rig-and-composition-deep-planner`
- **Capability tier:** `L0`
- **Truth-state policy:** Runtime status defaults to `Not Run`; Artifact status defaults to `Not Produced`; mutation rule is `downgrade_only` (never upgrade without verified evidence).

## When to use
- expanding an upstream scene brief from `product-hero-scene-planner` into detailed framing and camera direction
- defining focal hierarchy, viewer attention path, camera angle, focal length mood, and depth layering before lookdev
- aligning hero framing and negative space with web/UI copy overlays

## Trigger cues
- "improve composition and camera"
- "choose hero framing"
- "set camera strategy for product hero"

## When not to use
- as proof of rendered output quality or to validate an existing framing → delegate to `composition-quality-checker` (`references/skills/composition-quality-checker.md`; use composition-quality-checker)
- to design lighting rigs or surface materials/lookdev → delegate to `blender-lighting-material-planner` (`references/skills/blender-lighting-material-planner.md`; use blender-lighting-material-planner)
- to lock final pixel resolution or output aspect specs → delegate to `resolution-aspect-decision` (`references/skills/resolution-aspect-decision.md`; use resolution-aspect-decision)
- to choose delivery file formats → delegate to `output-format-decision` (`references/skills/output-format-decision.md`; use output-format-decision)
- when subject intent is undefined → delegate to `product-hero-scene-planner` (`references/skills/product-hero-scene-planner.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to product-hero-scene-planner)

## Inputs & output/evidence contract
### Required inputs
- `domain_scene_plan` (`object`): Upstream scene layout plan defining subject scale, staging, and depth layers
- `framing_goal` (`string`): Target shot type (hero three-quarter, orthographic catalog grid, portrait, wide establishing)

### Optional inputs
- `pinned_aspect_ratio` (`string`): Aspect ratio lock from resolution-aspect-decision

### Primary outputs
- `camera_rig_specification`
- `focal_length_and_dof_plan`
- `composition_anchor_guidelines`

## Quick-start procedure
1. confirm this skill fits your goal
2. provide required inputs first
3. keep runtime claims evidence-bound
4. follow suggested next-skill handoff

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- **Runtime boundary:** Planning-only skill: no Blender execution, no Python scripts, and no artifact generation. Runtime status stays `Not Run` and artifacts stay `Not Produced` (truth states are downgrade-only, never upgraded without verified evidence).
- executing Blender commands, writing Python scripts, or generating scene/render artifacts
- designing lighting setups or materials (owned by `blender-lighting-material-planner`)
- validating or scoring completed scene framing (owned by `composition-quality-checker`)
- locking output resolution/aspect standards (owned by `resolution-aspect-decision`) or file formats (owned by `output-format-decision`)
